generator_cmd: sh cobol_gen.sh   # real GnuCOBOL 3.2 (apt-get download gnucobol3 libcob4-dev libcob4t64; dpkg-deb -x tools/gnucobol/root; cobc drives system gcc), blob via python3 zlib.crc32+struct, gcc C decoy
oracle_cmd: sh cobol_oracle.sh cobol_decoy_badcrc.bin cobol_decoy.cob.txt decoy.cob   # file -b, readelf -dW/-lW, nm -D --undefined-only, objdump -d, strings -a, PROGRAM-ID + X literals of the COBOL source, zlib.crc32
note: real COBOL decoy: split X literals but the header crc is off by one -> no valid HCFG; facts still a COBOL program
